text: Ɓeyngu laamɗo on jokkitii o wi'i: Mi laɓɓinaa hoore-am e faandanagol bone, mi faandoraaki ɗum kadi laɓɓingol hoore-am; sabu wonkii neɗɗanke ko heewuki yamirde bone, tawde ki ooñoray e ko welataki, yiltugol ki e ɗum saɗta, si wanaa kin ki Alla yurmaa, O daɗnda ki e yamirgol bone. Pellet Joomi am ko Haforanoowo kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, Hinnotooɗo ɓe.
